🎀 Welcome to ADC Dance Studio! 🎀

────── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ──────

Step into the world of dance and creativity! Join our group to participate in fun dance classes, exciting competitions, dazzling showcases, and more!

✨ Features:

Premium members unlock special props and tools!

Get the VIP rank and your own VIP sign with the VIP Gamepass.

Private server owners get exclusive access to special commands.

────── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ──────

🎭 Host a roleplay with friends and express yourself on the dance floor! Be a dancer, a supportive parent, or a helpful coach- and help each other shine on stage!
